auth.label: Authenticate with Amazon
auth.description: Click to start the authentication process.

credentials.title: Enter your Amazon account details
credentials.description: Provide your Amazon sign-in details and the address of the companion API. You will complete any CAPTCHA or two-step verification on Amazon's own page in the next step.

amazon_login.title: Sign in to Amazon
amazon_login.description: Complete the Amazon sign-in in the window that opens, including any CAPTCHA or two-step verification.
